title: Oven-Roasted Indulgent Mexican Guanciale Tacos
description: Fresh, flaky, and rich Mexican Sonoran-style tacos featuring crispy guanciale and a clay-pot-cooked filling. Inspired by the bold flavors of the region, this dish combines tender meat with crunchy texture and explosive flavors.
instructions: Cook guanciale in a kadhai or large clay pot over medium heat until crispy, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine ground pork, diced onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Cook the pork mixture in the kadhai or clay pot over medium heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until browned and cooked through.
Stir in diced cilantro, lime juice, and olive oil. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by spooning pork mixture onto a warmed tortilla and topping with crispy guanciale, queso fresco, and additional cilantro if desired.
For best results, cook guanciale just before assembling the tacos.
Garnish with queso fresco, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice, if desired.
This dish is best served with additional toppings such as diced radishes, sliced avocado, and pickled onions.
Craving something a bit different, try substituting beef or chicken for the pork for a unique twist on this classic dish.
